title: iSCAT experimental platform
summary: Management of the construction of a complete iSCAT microscope and development of the experimental workflow, from component selection through acquisition, image analysis and interpretation of results.

sections.title: Context and funding
paragraphs: The project was carried out at King’s College London as part of a Postdoctoral Research Associate position presented publicly as an R&D Project Manager role.
items: Management of a €500,000 project funded by the BBSRC and co-funded by Oxford Nanopore Technologies.
Management of three doctoral researchers and two Master’s interns.

sections.title: Instrument construction and qualification
paragraphs: The iSCAT microscope was built from component procurement through optical table assembly and full instrument qualification.
items: Selection and procurement of optical and instrumental components.

sections.title: Experimental workflow
paragraphs: The project covered the design of the experimental workflow required for the scientific use of the instrument.
items: Design of protocols, samples and experiments.
Development of image-analysis methods and interpretation of results.

sections.title: Control and automation
paragraphs: LabVIEW software was developed to control and automate the microscope.
items: Development of instrument control using LabVIEW.
Development of scripts and analysis tools using Python, ImageJ macros and Java for ImageJ.

sections.title: Results and publications
paragraphs: The project resulted in the delivery of a complete and operational iSCAT microscope and several scientific publications.
items: Lead author of Spatial light modulation for interferometric scattering microscopy, Journal of Microscopy, 2024.
Co-author of Real-Time Monitoring and Control of Nanoparticle Formation, Journal of the American Chemical Society, 2023.
Co-author of Real-time label-free imaging of living crystallization-driven self-assembly, Nature Communications, 2025.
For both co-authored publications: contribution to equations, calculations, software, analysis scripts, manuscript review, advice and mentoring of the first author.
